owner_note.note: The line across the top is a bit to straight compare to the more "natural" curves found elsewhere in the design

taste.where: side_l: everything from the door light panel back to the tail is one plain black field, bigger than a door. top: the engine cover and rear deck are one plain black field, much bigger than the bonnet. rear34: the rear face and bumper are bare black apart from the sim's 451. The charcoal shed-skin scales barely show anywhere. All of this is plainer than 007's tonal facets on every panel.

front34 and crop-nose: the head is flat acid green with a few black slashes and the eyes. It has none of the body's diamond scales and none of the grey belly band, and no fangs show on the splitter lip, so the front is a different and flatter idea than the coil.

crop-nose and top: where the green head meets the black bonnet, behind the eyes and along the bonnet sides, the edge is a bare, ragged cut with no stroke. The ribbon's own edges (belly band on one side, pinline on the other) pass.
side_l: no zentiq reads from the left side. The only brand there is the small DENDROASPIS ZENTIQ tech label, and the low zentiq on the ribbon (seen in front34) doesn't read square-on.
front34: on the ribbon low behind the left front wheel, the z of zentiq sinks into the green scales, so the word reads as 'entiq'
side_r: at the front door shut line the ribbon's scales and belly plates jump out of line, so the body steps there instead of running on

fixes.text: The back half of the car is plain black. side_l: from the light panel to the tail. top: the whole engine cover and rear deck. rear34: the rear face and bumper. The charcoal shed-skin scales are too faint to see, so behind the coil there is no second layer at 10 m and the car looks front-heavy.

The head is flatter than the body. crop-nose and front34: the bonnet and bumper are one acid-green field with a few black slashes. There are no scales or belly tones on it, no grey fangs on the splitter lip, and its edge against the black bonnet (crop-nose, top) is a bare, ragged cut instead of a stroke.

The lead brand is weak. side_l: no zentiq reads from the left. front34: the low zentiq behind the front wheel reads as 'entiq' because its z merges into the scales. side_r: zentiq sits on a separate rectangular green patch over the haunch that isn't part of the snake. The small marks also fall short of fifteen: the sills, bumper corners and valance are mostly bare.

lint_missed: front34: the z of the low zentiq on the left ribbon disappears into the green scales, so the word reads as 'entiq'
side_r: the ribbon's scale pattern and belly plates step out of line at the front door shut line
side_r: the zentiq over the right haunch sits on a separate green block with a ragged edge, not on the snake's body
blocked: side_r: the ribbon steps at the front door shut line (seam-slant-step, a kit fault)
